props.name: variant
props.description: `media` (default): image/icon, text and actions. `dashboard`: a metric tile.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Media card layout. Defaults to `vertical`.

props.name: imageSrc
props.description: Image URL for the media area (ignored when the `icon` slot is used).

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alt text for the image. Defaults to empty (decorative).

props.name: title
props.description: Card title; rendered as a heading and used to label the card.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for the title (2-6). Defaults to `3`.

props.name: description
props.description: Body description text (override with the `description` slot for rich content).

props.name: value
props.description: Dashboard: the large metric value.

props.name: change
props.description: Dashboard: the smaller change/percentage shown beside the value.

props.name: trend
props.description: Dashboard: direction of the change, for coloring.
